sources.title: UltraBERT: One Encoder for Classification and Retrieval
sources.snippet: Following Cascade Distillation (Muralidharan et al., 2024; Liu et al., 2026), we start from our best 1.3B encoder, width-prune it to 380M and distill it, then prune the distilled 380M model to 150M and distill again. Both students learn directly from the 1.3B teacher rather than from the intermediate 380M model.

sources.title: Architecture graph for dmis-lab/UltraBERT-380M | hfviewer
sources.snippet: dmis-lab/UltraBERT-380M is a fill-mask model (ultrabert architecture). Its backbone uses 24 transformer layers, a hidden size of 1,024, and 8 attention heads (multi-head attention).

sources.title: UltraBERT: Beyond the Limit of BERT Pre-Training - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: DeBERTaV3-large achieves 78.1 and 25.8, whereas UltraBERT-380M achieves 78.5 and 48.7. Consistent with prior work, we observe substantially lower retrieval performance, with gaps of 24.6 and 22.9 points at the two sizes.
